SELECT fn_get_dynamic_seq('utb_customer')
INSERT INTO utb_customer ( customer_seq, office_seq, biz_info_seq, client_category_code, applicant_category_code, corp_category_code, attorney_category_code, client_name_ko, client_name_en, client_name_ch, client_name_jp, company_name, dept_name, customer_position, app_zip_code, app_address, app_tel, app_fax, contact_zip_code, contact_address, contact_person, contact_tel, contact_fax, etc_zip_code, etc_address, etc_tel, etc_fax, oversea_zip_code, oversea_address, oversea_tel, oversea_fax, country_code, resident_reg_no, corp_reg_no, kipo_client_no, manager_name, general_mandate_no, mobile, homepage, email, registration_date, case_classification, create_user, create_at, del_yn, note ) VALUES ( #{customerSeq}, #{officeSeq}, #{bizInfoSeq}, #{clientCategoryCode}, #{applicantCategoryCode}, #{corpCategoryCode}, #{attorneyCategoryCode}, #{clientNameKo}, #{clientNameEn}, #{clientNameCh}, #{clientNameJp}, #{companyName}, #{deptName}, #{customerPosition}, #{appZipCode}, #{appAddress}, #{appTel}, #{appFax}, #{contactZipCode}, #{contactAddress}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactTel}, #{contactFax}, #{etcZipCode}, #{etcAddress}, #{etcTel}, #{etcFax}, #{overseaZipCode}, #{overseaAddress}, #{overseaTel}, #{overseaFax}, #{countryCode}, #{residentRegNo}, #{corpRegNo}, #{kipoClientNo}, #{managerName}, #{generalMandateNo}, #{mobile}, #{homepage}, #{email}, NULLIF(#{registrationDate}, '')::timestamptz, '90', #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'N', #{note} )
mapper.select:
SELECT customer_seq AS "customerSeq", client_name_ko AS "clientNameKo", client_name_en AS "clientNameEn", company_name AS "companyName", country_code AS "countryCode", kipo_client_no AS "kipoClientNo", client_category_code AS "clientCategoryCode" FROM utb_customer WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'
AND client_category_code = '10' AND client_category_code = '20' AND client_category_code IN ('30', '40', '60') AND client_category_code = '50'
AND ( client_name_ko LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR client_name_en LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR company_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY client_name_ko ASC LIMIT COALESCE(#{pageSize}, 50) OFFSET COALESCE(#{offSet}, 0)

SELECT a.customer_seq AS "customerSeq" , a.client_name_ko AS "clientNameKo" , a.client_name_en AS "clientNameEn" , a.company_name AS "companyName" , a.country_code AS "countryCode" , a.kipo_client_no AS "kipoClientNo"
, b.biz_reg_no AS "bizRegNo" , c.order_no FROM utb_customer a LEFT JOIN utb_biz_info b ON a.biz_info_seq = b.biz_info_seq LEFT JOIN utb_customer_mapp c ON a.customer_seq = c.customer_seq WHERE a.office_seq = #{req.officeSeq} AND c.tbl_seq = #{req.tblSeq} AND c.customer_category_code = #{customerCategoryCode} AND a.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY a.create_at DESC

SELECT a.customer_seq AS counter_party_seq, COALESCE(b.client_name_ko, u.user_name_ko) AS counter_party_name, a.note AS counter_party_note, a.order_no AS counter_party_order_no FROM utb_customer_mapp a LEFT JOIN utb_customer b ON a.customer_seq = b.customer_seq AND b.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN utb_user_info u ON a.customer_seq = u.user_info_seq AND u.del_yn = 'N' WHERE a.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND a.tbl_seq = #{tblSeq} AND a.customer_category_code = #{customerCategoryCode} AND a.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY a.order_no DESC

SELECT c.*, b.biz_reg_no AS "bizRegNo", b.biz_workplace_no AS "bizWorkplaceNo", b.biz_corp_name AS "bizCorpName", b.ceo_name AS "ceoName", b.biz_addr AS "bizAddr", b.biz_type AS "bizType", b.biz_kind AS "bizKind", b.reg_discount_code AS "regDiscountCode", b.reduction_reason AS "reductionReason", TO_CHAR(b.reduction_issue_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AS "reductionIssueDate", TO_CHAR(b.discount_closing_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AS "discountClosingDate" FROM utb_customer c LEFT JOIN utb_biz_info b ON c.biz_info_seq = b.biz_info_seq WHERE c.customer_seq = #{customerSeq} AND c.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND c.del_yn = 'N'

mapper.update: UPDATE utb_customer SET office_seq = #{officeSeq}, biz_info_seq = #{bizInfoSeq}, client_category_code = #{clientCategoryCode}, applicant_category_code = #{applicantCategoryCode}, corp_category_code = #{corpCategoryCode}, attorney_category_code = #{attorneyCategoryCode}, client_name_ko = #{clientNameKo}, client_name_en = #{clientNameEn}, client_name_ch = #{clientNameCh}, client_name_jp = #{clientNameJp}, company_name = #{companyName}, dept_name = #{deptName}, customer_position = #{customerPosition}, app_zip_code = #{appZipCode}, app_address = #{appAddress}, app_tel = #{appTel}, app_fax = #{appFax}, contact_zip_code = #{contactZipCode}, contact_address = #{contactAddress}, contact_person = #{contactPerson}, contact_tel = #{contactTel}, contact_fax = #{contactFax}, etc_zip_code = #{etcZipCode}, etc_address = #{etcAddress}, etc_tel = #{etcTel}, etc_fax = #{etcFax}, oversea_zip_code = #{overseaZipCode}, oversea_address = #{overseaAddress}, oversea_tel = #{overseaTel}, oversea_fax = #{overseaFax}, country_code = #{countryCode}, resident_reg_no = #{residentRegNo}, corp_reg_no = #{corpRegNo}, kipo_client_no = #{kipoClientNo}, manager_name = #{managerName}, general_mandate_no = #{generalMandateNo}, mobile = #{mobile}, homepage = #{homepage}, email = #{email}, registration_date = NULLIF(#{registrationDate}, '')::timestamptz, note = #{note}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE customer_seq = #{customerSeq} AND office_seq = #{officeSeq}
